guide.description: -b:a sets the target audio bitrate — how many kilobits per second the encoded audio uses. Lower bitrates make smaller files at the cost of quality; podcasts and voice are usually fine well below music-quality bitrates.

flags.desc: target audio bitrate in kbps, e.g. 128k

exercises.title: Set the audio bitrate
exercises.task: Convert podcast-ep1.wav to podcast-ep1-128.mp3 at a bitrate of 128k.
hints: -b:a <rate>k goes between -i <input> and the output file
